title: Attitude Dynamics
text: Model attitude dynamics of one or more spacecraft, 10 inputs, 7 outputs, {Attitude representation} sets Orientation format; {Input body moments} sets the option to enable external moments, {State vector coordinate frame} sets the position and velocity state port coordinate frame, {Start date/time (UTC Julian date)} sets the initial start time for simulation, {Output current date/time (UTC Julian date)} sets the option to add output port t utc, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior, {Mass type} sets the spacecraft mass type, {Mass} sets the initial mass of rigid body spacecraft, {Empty mass} sets the spacecraft empty mass, {Full mass} sets the spacecraft full mass, {Inertia tensor}, {Empty inertia tensor}, {Full inertia tensor}, {Include mass flow relative velocity} sets the option to enable mass flow velocity, {Limit mass flow when mass is empty or full} sets the option to limit mass flow, {Output fuel tank status} sets the option to enable fuel tank status, {Attitude reference coordinate frame} sets the attitude and angular rate coordinate frame, {Initial body attitude} sets the spacecraft initial attitude, {Angle rotation order}, {Initial body angular rates PQR} sets the initial body-fixed angular rates, {Include gravity gradient torque} sets the option to enable gravity gradient torque, {Central body} sets the celestial body around which spacecraft orbits, {Rotational rate}, {Use Earth orientation parameters (EOPs)} sets the option to use Earth orientation parameters, {IERS EOP data file} sets the earth orientation data, {Input Moon libration angles} sets the moon libration Euler angle rate, {Output quaternion (ICRF to Fixed-frame)} sets the option to add output transformation quaternion, {Central body spin axis source} sets the central body spin, {Spin axis right ascension (RA) at J2000} sets the right ascension of central body spin axis, {Spin axis RA rate (deg/century)} sets the right ascension rate of central body spin, {Spin axis declination (Dec) at J2000} sets the declination of central body spin axis, {Spin axis Dec rate (deg/century)} sets the declination rate of central body spin axis, {Initial rotation angle at J2000} sets the rotation angle of central body x -axis, {Rotation rate (deg/day)} sets the rotation rate of central body x -axis, {Equatorial radius}, {Flattening}, {Gravitational parameter}, {Units} sets the parameter and port units Metric, {Angle units} and {Time format}. Values come from the instance.
